title: Plan Breakdown
description: How a scheduled-media plan is built, in the terms radio, linear TV and out-of-home buyers plan in: headline totals, and allocations along named dimensions (market, station, programming format, daypart, week, spot length). It is a view of the proposal, not a second source of terms: commercial_terms stays authoritative for what is bought, and the proposal's forecast stays authoritative for any metric both state. A seller that reports it for a proposal reports it for every version of that negotiation, so figures compare across versions. Each dimension appears at most once, and `custom` at most once per custom_dimension. Its figures are the seller's point estimates for the plan priced at the proposal's total budget: where the proposal's forecast has a point at that budget they equal its mid values, and the forecast stays authoritative. audience_basis states the units every reach, audience and GRP figure is read in; when it is omitted, the proposal forecast's demographic, measurement_source and reach_unit apply.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency of every monetary figure in the breakdown.

cost_basis.description: Whether budget, CPP and CPM are gross or net of agency commission. Absent means the seller's quoting convention.

breakdowns.description: Allocations by dimension. Dimensions MUST be unique, except custom, which MUST be unique by custom_dimension. A seller that reports a dimension reports it complete or marks it truncated.
